fusions.name: Snapped Lash
fusions.desc: A lash from range that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at its full reach of 6 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 5 seconds. It holds 3 charges and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Springboard Splash
fusions.desc: Springs you to an enemy up to 6 tiles away and lands, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and leaves each one [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Glance Away
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% for 6 seconds. You finish it 3 tiles from where you stood, with +10% dodge chance for it.

fusions.name: Pond Company
fusions.desc: A bonded tadpole follows you and fights beside you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. It also makes them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.
